mentions.name: Blackjack Card Counting Learning Tool
mentions.description: This tool teaches blackjack card counting, taking users from complete novice to advanced winning card counter. It uses a Duolingo-like approach with mastery-based learning across sequential modules and also teaches how to identify winnable games, without ads or dark patterns.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a blackjack card counting tool for people to learn how to count and how to identify games that are winnable. It is designed to take a completely novice to an advanced, winning card counter, using a Duolingo like approach - mastery based learning across sequential modules. Minus the ads and dark patterns.
